name: ML-Embed-0.6B (ML-Embed family 140M to 8B)

lineage.how_derived: two-stage embedding training from F2LLM-v2-0.6B-Preview with 3D Matryoshka learning (layers, embedding factorization, output dimension)

purpose: Inclusive and efficient multilingual embeddings: one model deployable at several sizes through layer truncation (MLL), factorized embedding matrices (MEL) and dimension truncation (MRL) (paper arXiv 2605.15081, ICML 2026).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card metadata tag; the HF repo's LICENSE file was not checked, so the text was not read. HF createdAt 2026-05-15.

architecture.kind: dense decoder transformer used as encoder (Qwen3-0.6B), EOS-token pooling, causal attention
architecture.why_this_design: Matryoshka at three axes (MLL, MEL, MRL) so one checkpoint serves several deployment budgets; the default checkpoint is a standard Qwen3 model loadable without code changes (card).

variants.notes: 1024-d; only the 0.6B repo was publicly listed; the 4B and 8B repos returned 401 on the API

engine_support.notes: Standard Qwen3 loading; a llama.cpp qwen3 embedding path should apply but was not tested.

benchmarks.name: MTEB benchmarks with new records (vendor claim in abstract)

strengths: flexible layer, dimension and embedding-size truncation
weaknesses: no numbers for the 0.6B on the card or the abstract
no independent evaluation or user report found
best_for: multilingual retrieval where one checkpoint must scale across hardware
soft.maturity: CodeFuse AI research group; paper at ICML 2026; very new, no community track record found.

tona_fit.reason: Same size and architecture as Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B with an Apache tag; no read score yet that shows it beats Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, and no independent evidence. Run our own test before replacing the default.

open_questions: MMTEB and MTEB Code numbers for the 0.6B (paper tables not read)
Are the 4B and 8B weights published (API returned 401)?
